title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k`-th largest element in the array. Note this is the k-th largest in sorted order, not necessarily the k-th distinct value.
hints: Sorting works but is O(n log n) — can you do better with a heap?
A min-heap of size k, where you push each number and pop when the heap exceeds k, leaves the k-th largest at the top.
Python's heapq module gives you a min-heap directly, or consider heapq.nlargest.
